About these 5 rides

They ride on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays; Saturday and Sunday have the most, 2 each. Starts run from 8:00 am to 5:30 pm. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop). There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders. By bike: 4 road and 2 social. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 2, 2026.

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
